entry.content: sprkly_create_automation_from_template: description, inputSchema +Links are checked: a link that looks like WhatsApp but is not wa.me, a link with look-alike or accented letters, and a link that hides where it goes with a part before an @ are refused (link_required). Links typed into message, comment_reply, faq answers and fallback get the same checks (link_refused, invalid_faq), and there http is fine too. +One DM per person per post: someone who already got an automated DM on a post gets no second one there, even from another automation or a new comment. That skip is normal, not a fault. The owner gets an email when an automation goes live through here. parameters: +Refused: a link that does not start with https://, a link that looks like WhatsApp but is not wa.me, a link with look-alike or accented letters, and a link that hides where it goes with a part before an @. sprkly_delete_scheduled_post: description +post moves to the Bin, and the -the Deleted tab +there +A post that is going out right now is refused with publishing_now; one that got stuck while going out is refused with stuck_publishing. sprkly_get_account_summary: description +accountLimit (how many accounts the plan allows, extra accounts included), monthlyPosts (posts used this month against the monthly cap, null when there is no cap), dailyPosts (only on a plan with a daily cap, by UTC day), sprkly_get_analytics: description +LinkedIn and Telegram report no numbers yet. sprkly_get_automation_insights: description +One DM per person per post: a comment from someone who already got a DM on that post sends nothing, so comments in can run ahead of people messaged. That is the rule working, not a fault. sprkly_get_billing_summary: description -handles +handles, accountLimit, monthlyPosts (null when the plan has no monthly cap), dailyPosts (only on a plan with a daily cap) sprkly_pause_automation: description +The owner gets an email saying it was paused. sprkly_resume_automation: description -again. +again, and the owner gets an email saying so. sprkly_schedule_post: inputSchema parameters: +X 280, Bluesky 300, Threads 500, +LinkedIn 3,000, -Threads 500. +Facebook 63,206, Telegram 4,096 as text alone and 1,024 with a photo or video. +Too long for a target is refused with caption_too_long. sprkly_update_scheduled_post: description, inputSchema +Refusals carry a code: approval_pending (the caption, media and accounts are locked while it waits for approval; the time can still change), publishing_now (it is going out right now), post_changed (it changed since you read it: read it again), stuck_publishing (it got stuck while going out: send the user to support@sprkly.app), caption_too_long (too long for one of its targets). parameters: +X 280, Bluesky 300, Threads 500, +LinkedIn 3,000, -Threads 500. +Facebook 63,206, Telegram 4,096 as text alone and 1,024 with a photo or video. added sprkly_archive_automation added sprkly_repost added sprkly_restore_from_bin added sprkly_update_automation introduced -- sprkly_update_scheduled_post: signal:exfiltration

omit to leave BANDWIDTH selling unchanged. +input.poolSetting.energy description: Auto-sell rules for staked ENERGY; omit to leave ENERG tronsave_suggest_create_order: inputSchema parameters: +description: ENERGY (smart-contract calls) or BANDWIDTH (plain transfers). input.resourceType tronsave_update_auto_sell_setting: inputSchema parameters: +input.addOnFeature description: Optional extras: voting, auto-stake of idle TRX, suggest-sell hints. +input.paymentConfig description: Where and how often seller earnings are paid out (address, DAILY/IMMEDIATE, payout window). +input.poolSetting description: What the wallet sells automatically: per-resource price floor, duration bounds, minimum amount, reserve, and reclaim scope. +input.poolSetting.bandwidth description: Auto-sell rules for staked BANDWIDTH;
